name: verified-workflows
description: Root-owned Codex workflow orchestration with deterministic feasibility review and opt-in strict receipt gates.

interface.shortDescription: Run root-owned workflows with feasible evidence gates.
interface.longDescription: Defines Codex-native workflow DAGs, logical roles, reviewer and validator gates, and evidence contracts while the root thread retains mutation and completion authority. Strict child receipts are opt-in when the runtime can attest them.
defaultPrompt: Use verified-workflows:run to execute this approved workflow with explicit roles, barriers, and evidence gates.
